message:
get operation is missing an operationId
how to fix: Add an `operationId` so generated SDK methods carry a stable name.

operation `<unnamed>` (get) declares no `default` or 4XX/5XX response
how to fix: Add a `default` response or a 4XX/5XX response so client error handling is predictable.

GET operation has no `operationId`; SDK generation falls back to `GET /pets` selection
how to fix: Add an `operationId` so generated SDK methods carry a stable name.

path `/pets/{petId}` uses template variable `{petId}` but no `in: path` parameter declares it
how to fix: Declare every `{var}` in the path as an `in: path` parameter on the path item or operation.
